metadata.question: Did the snow water equivelent at Donner Pass higher in February than April in 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Collection: Use GRACE/GRACE-FO GLDAS assimilation or NLDAS "GLDAS-2.1_NOAH025_3H" which contains SWE (Snow Water Equivalent) in kg m-2. 2. Periods: February 2022 ("2022-02-01":"2022-02-28") and April 2022 ("2022-04-01":"2022-04-30"). 3. Location: Donner Pass, CA (around -120.32, 39.32). 4. Cloud masking: not needed; SWE is a land-surface model dataset, no clouds. 5. Logic: monthly mean SWE in Feb 2022 vs Apr 2022; compare the two means and decide higher/lower. 6. Validation: - Check collection size for each month – C1 if 0 images. - Count valid SWE pixels per month (should always have global land coverage, but test) – C2 if 0. - Verify numeric values are within normal SWE ranges; singular NaN/None => C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # Donner Pass location pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.32, 39.32]) # SWE dataset # Typical variable name: SWE_inst (kg/m^2 == mm) c = ee.ImageCollection("NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H") # February 2022 febC = c.filterDate("2022-02-01", "2022-02-28").select("SWE_inst") if febC.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No GLDAS images for Feb 2022.") print("C1") # April 2022 aprC = c.filterDate("2022-04-01", "2022-04-30").select("SWE_inst") if aprC.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No GLDAS images for Apr 2022.") print("C1") # Monthly mean SWE def monthlyMean(col, label): img = col.mean() mean = img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=pt, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get("SWE_inst") count = img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=pt, scale=25000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get("SWE_inst") m = mean.getInfo() c = count.getInfo() if m is None or c is None: raise RuntimeError("Failed calc") print(f"{label}: SWE = {m:.1f} mm, Pixels = {int(c)}") return m febMean = monthlyMean(febC, "Feb 2022") aprMean = monthlyMean(aprC, "Apr 2022") # Compare if febMean is None or aprMean is None: print("C3") elif febMean > aprMean: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# Donner Pass location
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.32, 39.32])

# SWE dataset
# Typical variable name: SWE_inst (kg/m^2 == mm)
c = ee.ImageCollection("NASA/GLDAS/V021/NOAH/G025/T3H")

# February 2022
febC = c.filterDate("2022-02-01", "2022-02-28").select("SWE_inst")
if febC.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No GLDAS images for Feb 2022.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# April 2022
aprC = c.filterDate("2022-04-01", "2022-04-30").select("SWE_inst")
if aprC.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No GLDAS images for Apr 2022.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# Monthly mean SWE
def monthlyMean(col, label):
    img = col.mean()
    mean = img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=pt,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get("SWE_inst")
    count = img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=pt,
        scale=25000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get("SWE_inst")
    m = mean.getInfo()
    c = count.getInfo()
    if m is None or c is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Failed calc")
    print(f"{label}: SWE = {m:.1f} mm, Pixels = {int(c)}")
    return m

febMean = monthlyMean(febC, "Feb 2022")
aprMean = monthlyMean(aprC, "Apr 2022")

# Compare
if febMean is None or aprMean is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif febMean > aprMean:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")

<answer>B</answer>
